practicalAssessorReference: Isolation: personal lock and hasp plus a try test before entering the footprint.
Access/egress: three points of contact at all times.
Start-up: horn once before starting the engine; horn twice before moving off.
Idling: no more than 20 minutes; 3-5 minutes idle/cool-down before shutdown.
Steep slopes: max lateral slope 33 degrees; engine braking descending; avoid lateral travel on steep slopes.
Ripping: boot slightly below the tyne heel; decelerator to prevent track spin; never turn or reverse with the tyne buried; regularly check the boot is attached.
Dozing: slot dozing front-to-back; windrow width no more than 1/3 of the blade.
40m exclusion zone around other SME, RGVs, LVs and personnel; stop and ground G.E.T. before allowing traffic to pass.
Float loading: spotter communication, low gear, park and shut down only on signal; lower attachments, park brake, engine off, battery isolated before dismounting.
Catch bunds/windrows minimum 1.5m on any face, road or work-area edge.
Bogged machine: stop, no track spin, notify supervisor, JHA before recovery.
